title: sale_timesheet — service billing chain SO→timesheet→invoice L3 depth
key_finding: The delivery-timesheet billing chain is fully implemented: SOL qty_delivered_method is overridden to 'timesheet' for products with service_type='timesheet' and invoice_policy='delivery'; delivered quantity aggregates unit_amount from analytic lines; invoice creation stamps timesheet_invoice_id on qualifying entries; posted invoices lock the timesheet from modification; credit notes and modify-reversals restore the billable state.
chain_steps: 2. SOL: _compute_qty_delivered_method sets qty_delivered_method='timesheet' for non-expense service+timesheet products
3. Timesheet: employee logs hours; so_line auto-computed via _timesheet_determine_sale_line() per pricing_type
4. Delivered qty: _prepare_qty_delivered() aggregates unit_amount from analytic lines with project and matching so_line
6. Lock: invoiced timesheets cannot be modified or deleted; credit note posting clears the lock
